- [x] `TypeScript repo: installing/commands/test/update/recursive.ts:416` `recursive update with aliased workspace dependency (#7975)` — ported as `recursive_update_keeps_an_aliased_workspace_dependency`.

- [ ] `TypeScript repo: installing/commands/test/update/recursive.ts` — the remaining five cases move `latest` mid-test with `addDistTag`. The fixture registry derives `dist-tags.latest` from the highest published version and has no per-run override, so they stay unported. See pnpm/pnpm#12101.

-- [x] `TypeScript repo: installing/commands/test/update/jsr.ts:25` `jsr without alias` — the install half is the real `install_records_a_plain_jsr_dependency` in `crates/cli/tests/update_jsr.rs`; the `--latest` half is a `known_failures` port, since pacquet never rewrites `jsr:` specifiers (pnpm/pnpm#13363).

-- [x] `TypeScript repo: installing/commands/test/update/jsr.ts:91` `jsr with alias` — ported as two `known_failures` cases, `install_records_an_aliased_jsr_dependency` and `update_latest_bumps_an_aliased_jsr_dependency`, so the importer gap (pnpm/pnpm#13362) does not hide the `--latest` half (pnpm/pnpm#13363).

+- [x] `TypeScript repo: installing/commands/test/update/jsr.ts:91` `jsr with alias` — ported as two `known_failures` cases, `install_records_an_aliased_jsr_dependency` and `update_latest_bumps_an_aliased_jsr_dependency`, still gated on the importer gap (pnpm/pnpm#13362).

- [ ] `TypeScript repo: installing/commands/test/update/interactive.ts` and `issue-7415.ts` — both drive the prompt programmatically by mocking `@inquirer/prompts`. pacquet prompts through `dialoguer`, which wants a TTY and has no injection seam, so these need that seam first.
